sources.title: British Columbia Transit Statement of Financial Information, year ended March 31, 2016

validation.method: Two OCR renderings, image-reviewed disagreements, complete page review and printed-subtotal reconciliation

notes: Accepted 177 named employees from the complete official employee schedule, physical PDF pages 7-11. Board members, suppliers and aggregate rows are excluded.

Named remuneration is $16,304,943; expenses are $507,681. Rows minus printed named subtotals: remuneration +0, expenses +0. Residuals are within the independent whole-dollar rounding bound; individual values are unchanged and the source does not establish the cause.
The remuneration note states 27 pay period cycle (2015 - 26 pay periods). Pay includes gross pay, taxable benefits and banked-time payouts; it is not an annual salary rate.
The employee schedule publishes names and amounts but no positions. Expense dashes are recorded as zero; missing positions remain null.

sources.title: British Columbia Transit Statement of Financial Information, year ended March 31, 2021

validation.method: Two OCR renderings, explicit image-reviewed corrections, complete page review and printed-subtotal reconciliation

notes: Recovered 385 named employees from the official image-only 2020/21 employee schedule, PDF pages 6–13. Board payments, below-threshold aggregates and suppliers are excluded.

Named row sums are $36,243,255 remuneration and $320,215 expenses. Printed named subtotals are $36,243,253 and $320,208. The +$2 and +$7 variances are within whole-dollar rounding bounds; source row values are preserved without balancing adjustments.

The report states that 2021 remuneration covers 27 pay periods, compared with 26 in 2020, and includes gross pay, taxable benefits and banked-time payouts. Year-to-year changes therefore are not simply changes in salary rates.
The source publishes names and amounts but no employee positions. Dashes in the expense column are recorded as zero; position is null.
